title: Creating Your First Store
description: Complete guide to setting up your first online store in Matjrii, from creation to going live.
content:
Creating Your First Store

After completing your account setup, the next step is to create your first online store. This guide will walk you through the entire process.

Prerequisites

Before creating a store, ensure you have:

  • Completed your account registration
  • Selected a subscription plan
  • Decided on your store name and niche

Step 1: Access Store Creation

Navigate to your dashboard and click on "Stores" in the sidebar menu. Click the "Create Store" button.

Step 2: Basic Store Information

Fill in your store details:

  • Store Name: Choose a unique name for your store
  • Store Slug: This will be used in your store URL (e.g., yourstore.matjrii.com)
  • Description: Brief description of what your store sells
  • Category: Select the industry or category your store belongs to

Step 3: Store Theme Selection

Choose from 10+ professional themes designed for different industries. You can preview themes before selecting and change them later.

Step 4: Initial Configuration

Configure basic settings:

  • Currency selection
  • Timezone
  • Language preferences
  • Store status (Active/Inactive)

Step 5: Save and Continue

Click "Create Store" to save your store. You'll be redirected to the store settings page where you can further customize your store.

Next Steps

Now that your store is created, learn about:

  • Store Settings & Configuration
  • Adding Your First Products
  • Customizing Your Store Theme
meta_description: Step-by-step guide to creating your first online store in Matjrii, including theme selection and initial configuration.
